fault_cases.trigger: Candidate JSON self-asserts accepted=true.
fault_cases.expected: Reject before opening a write connection.
fault_cases.required_evidence: HostAuthorityPort negative fixture

fault_cases.trigger: Source commit or applicability changes before execution.
fault_cases.expected: Reject stale candidate; no write.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Controlled source port revision change

fault_cases.trigger: Source changes after commit but before readback.
fault_cases.expected: Keep receipt; committed-but-not-adoptable; recall rejects.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Post-commit source port revision change

fault_cases.trigger: Procedure omits prerequisites or source evidence.
fault_cases.expected: Reject candidate; do not store incomplete method.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Schema validation negative fixtures

fault_cases.trigger: Provenance makes complete version exceed 16384 bytes.
fault_cases.expected: Reject without truncating provenance or body.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Canonical UTF-8 boundary fixtures

fault_cases.trigger: Process exits before/during/after commit and reply is lost.
fault_cases.expected: Fresh readback distinguishes applied/not-applied/unknown without replay.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Subprocess crash injection; exception before commit alone is insufficient

fault_cases.trigger: A nonempty journal exists before an audit.
fault_cases.expected: Report recovery-required before opening DB; all files byte-identical.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Synthetic hot/non-hot journal plus file inventory/hash comparison

fault_cases.trigger: Two pages span a concurrent writer or closed snapshot.
fault_cases.expected: Same snapshot remains consistent; expired cursor rejects; no mixed completeness.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Two-process coordination-lock and cursor tests

fault_cases.trigger: Stop/update/restore changes current revision.
fault_cases.expected: Current pointer, active-only exact-cue projection and proof agree atomically.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Independent new connection reads all state components

fault_cases.trigger: A write would exceed profile.max_items, profile.max_proofs or the measured data/growth limit.
fault_cases.expected: Refuse capacity-increasing write; preserve history/markers; maintenance reserve is bounded.
fault_cases.required_evidence: At-limit and one-over cases, including stopped items and pending proofs

fault_cases.trigger: UTC or monotonic clock moves backwards, confirmation expires, or process restarts.
fault_cases.expected: Reject mutation/retention; no extension of previous confirmation.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Trusted clock port boundary and restart cases

fault_cases.trigger: Erase a canary-bearing item with history and derived cues.
fault_cases.expected: No adoption after transaction; sanitization remains pending until all managed readable files and paths checked.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Synthetic canary scan of main/journal/temp/history/index, not SQL absence alone

fault_cases.trigger: Incremental vacuum reclaims zero/some pages, then is interrupted.
fault_cases.expected: Preserve erase result; actual bytes reported; remaining space reclaim is pending.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Bounded incremental_vacuum with subprocess interruption and independent readback

fault_cases.trigger: Filesystem runs out of space during transaction or compact.
fault_cases.expected: Never claim success from exception; preserve unknown/pending states and recover under explicit authority.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Restricted disposable filesystem or SQLite fault VFS, not a mock-only claim

fault_cases.trigger: Proof/marker retention crosses 30-day boundary with an in-flight operation.
fault_cases.expected: Protect pending/reference-bearing records; advance reject floor atomically before exact-set pruning.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Boundary clock, crash and stale-operation replay cases

fault_cases.trigger: Unexpected WAL/SHM or temp location, stale qualification/file binding, invalid J/T/G/R, or execution-time available space below R.
fault_cases.expected: Do not open mutation transaction; incomplete coverage or qualification never authorizes operation. Preserve unknown files; fresh free-space changes still meeting R do not expand scope.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Synthetic arithmetic/binding boundaries; later trusted registry, peak, preallocated maintenance capacity and execution-time filesystem qualification

fault_cases.trigger: Sensitivity classification is unknown/prohibited or the policy fingerprint changes.
fault_cases.expected: Reject storage/adoption; redaction requires a new complete candidate and preview.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Trusted source/sensitivity port negative fixtures, not a keyword-only detector

fault_cases.trigger: Historical versions are removed but process exits before canary verification.
fault_cases.expected: Preserve current version and sanitization-pending proof; deleted history never returns.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Transaction/crash plus main/journal/temp/history canary scan

fault_cases.trigger: A prune continuation has only item permission but residue work needs root maintenance.
fault_cases.expected: Reject remaining maintenance; keep precise pending phases without replaying SQL deletion.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Scope/proof-digest/phase-bound continuation and fresh readback

fault_cases.trigger: A scope, nonce, candidate, policy, state digest or confirmation expiry is changed.
fault_cases.expected: Reject mismatched canonical binding; a matching synthetic JSON never grants authority.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Offline envelope mutation cases and later qualified port tests

fault_cases.trigger: External-copy coverage or known copy set changes after confirmation.
fault_cases.expected: Rebuild and reconfirm preview; unknown never becomes no external copies.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Synthetic coverage/digest drift case; no external resource reads

fault_cases.trigger: A restore source revision is omitted, changed or not retained.
fault_cases.expected: Reject; preview and durable proof must bind the same exact retained source revision.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Synthetic source-revision substitution negatives

fault_cases.trigger: Content write commits but post-write storage is absent, over limit or incompletely measured.
fault_cases.expected: Preserve committed proof; committed-capacity-unproven, not applied/not-applied; block growth.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Synthetic byte/coverage boundaries plus later actual filesystem measurement

fault_cases.trigger: A retention target batch has 129 proofs or markers, or full encoded envelope exceeds 256 KiB.
fault_cases.expected: Reject without truncation; each at-most-128 batch has its own preview/confirmation/proof.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Maximum complete-envelope canonical encoding and one-over batch tests

fault_cases.trigger: Valid new confirmation resumes exact pending sanitization on the original proof.
fault_cases.expected: Atomically update only original phase fields and insert child proof with new acceptance metadata; fresh readback checks both.
fault_cases.required_evidence: Positive synthetic before/after proof-set example and later crash/partial-write tests

fault_cases.trigger: retention/continuation commit succeeds and the process loses its reply
fault_cases.expected: fresh readback verifies durable witness manifest and before/after set roots without RAM preview; mismatch is never applied
fault_cases.required_evidence: synthetic before/after records and exact-set/parent tamper negatives

fault_cases.trigger: compact has N=0, N exceeds freelist, N changes after confirmation, or durable freelist changes while its parent witness is still pending/null
fault_cases.expected: reject invalid plans; pending with freelist drift is state-unknown and cannot replay N; qualified PRAGMA, metadata and phase effects must commit atomically
fault_cases.required_evidence: bound plan with N=2 and actual=1 positive, invalid N and inconsistent pending negatives; G2 transaction/rollback and metadata allocation qualification

fault_cases.trigger: restore points to a retained revision but substitutes semantic content
fault_cases.expected: reject; changed semantics must use update and fresh validation
fault_cases.required_evidence: retained source and new lifecycle/validation positive plus semantic substitution negative

fault_cases.trigger: retained witness or pending continuation liability exhausts reserved capacity
fault_cases.expected: reject new admission without pruning; existing pending work retains reserved proof and witness slots
fault_cases.required_evidence: 64KiB witness limit, count/byte estimate and future runtime admission boundary tests

fault_cases.trigger: applied result reuses preflight external-copy observation or another filesystem capacity
fault_cases.expected: reject stale or mismatched evidence; do not declare global erase
fault_cases.required_evidence: fresh post observations and foreign-filesystem negative
